g.text: BCA graduate focused on SOC Operations, Security Monitoring
and Log Analysis. Hands-on with Splunk, Windows Event Logs,
PowerShell, Sysmon and the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
Comfortable analysing security telemetry, writing detections,
investigating alerts and following incident-response workflows.

svg.text: Open to SOC / Cloud Security opportunities.
“Every log has a story. Every alert has a truth.”
